notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's family-config/ros helper guessed RosDriver from the repository being ROS 2 + Gazebo. The confirmed entry symbol sdrl_rl_controller.sdrl_rl_controller.train_sac:QuadcopterTrackingEnv (src/sdrl_rl_controller/sdrl_rl_controller/train_sac.py:50, confidence ast) is a Gymnasium environment, and the authoring guide says a Gymnasium environment does not become a ROS transport driver merely because its repository also contains ROS nodes. This package therefore uses GymnasiumDriver; the ROS topics and services are internal to the environment's Gazebo/navigator loop (train_sac.py:189-201). The clone contains no gym.register call, so no registered Gymnasium id was invented and env_id is None; the training entry constructs the class directly (train_sac.py:795-801). The bridge derives cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1. The step action bounds are the upstream four-element Box [-1, 1], cited at train_sac.py:152-156 (upstream_code), so REFERENCE.md shows that source and ref. The observation is the upstream eleven-element Box [-1, 1]. NOT COVERED: the upstream environment was never imported or run; it imports rclpy, torch, stable_baselines3 and clone modules (train_sac.py:14-39), needs a ROS 2 Humble + Gazebo Harmonic graph, and package code never imports or runs the clone. No sim backend is declared and no upstream simulator, ROS graph, Gazebo physics, hardware or hardware run is claimed. The checked fake backend is this package's analytic pure Python point-mass/attitude stand-in (fake.py), not a recording and not a transcript: it mirrors action_space, observation_space, reset(seed, options), step(action) and close, the 11-value observation layout, the 4-value force/torque action layout and the upstream reward terms, but its values, trajectories, target, reset sequence, crash test and success radius are placeholders and it was never compared with the upstream simulator. One tick is one 10 ms control step; the upstream ten 1 kHz physics steps are not simulated. The upstream reset draws x/y jitter from the global numpy generator (train_sac.py:582-584) and documents residual velocity after reset (train_sac.py:574-576, docs/StalkerDroneRL.md:46-54); the fake uses per-instance random.Random and zeroes velocity, so upstream determinism is not claimed. One environment instance is served, matching the upstream ban on n_envs other than 1 (train_sac.py:771-779). Snapshot/restore is not offered because the upstream class has no get_state/set_state. Expected family warnings left by the gate: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the Gymnasium bridge only buffers the seed for the next reset, as the authoring guide documents) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived inputs (reset seed, seed, ticks and action.values). G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warning. The clone at commit e34db1c6a4926d22b447aa1ef93e9bb0bad4793c was read only and stays unmodified. No catalogue extension ids are used, so there are no catalogue_requests. driver.lock.json records authored_by {"kind": "model", "model_id": "deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017", "run_id": "ros-wave-c-086"} and reviewed_by null; no human reviewed or tested this package and no hardware was attached.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the GymnasiumDriver deviation, action_space_ref (train_sac.py:152-156), every fact, the fake against action_to_wrench and the reward code, the seed path and the stop text at the pin. The deviation is right (QuadcopterTrackingEnv is a gym.Env whose ROS 2 topics and gz-transport calls are internal; the clone has no gym.register id) and the fake maps the action as action_to_wrench does. Defects: safe_state said the simulation stops advancing, but only the in-process fake does: the training launch starts Gazebo running (train_sac_launch.py:94-105), the upstream step requests ten iterations with a WorldControl message whose pause field it never sets (gz_client.py:37-47), and nothing zeroes the last motor speeds; eight facts said more than their ranges (the step fact's tracking error and reward lay outside 362-397, terminated and truncated outside 422-434, the hover thrust outside 14-16, 'body-frame' outside 90-130, judgements on constructor options and reward caps, 'progress toward a moving command position', and a 'known issue' list the documentation does not contain); the upstream step's swallowed observation timeout (_wait_for_odom returns after 2 s of wall-clock time with only a warning, 219-238) and the stock constructor's lifecycle hazards were not disclosed; and two test cases assert seeded repeats the upstream does not have (reset(seed) does not seed the global numpy generator that draws the start position, 582-584). The reviewer rewrote safe_state, corrected eight facts (the constructor fact now also states rclpy.init and the use_sim_time default) and added five (_wait_for_odom, gz_client.world_control, the post-reset wait timed on the node clock, hover_thrust, the training launch's gz sim -r), and added five fidelity gaps (driver.py); labelled the seed, crash and e-stop cases fake-only (test_driver.py); updated facts.md; and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate and collect.py --strict pass with the expected G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings and the digest unchanged; the override proposal records the gymnasium family. For the human reviewer: Fake-only contract; no sim backend is declared. Constructing the upstream QuadcopterTrackingEnv inside the server would call the global rclpy.init, start a daemon rclpy.spin thread and, on importing gz_client, create a gz-transport node; reset waits on two Trigger services and then on odometry with a 5 s timeout measured on the node clock (simulated time by default, so it never elapses while /clock is silent) and raises RuntimeError on failure; close() calls the global rclpy.shutdown and joins the spin thread without a timeout. The MHS latch would not pause a live Gazebo world: the training launch runs Gazebo unpaused, each upstream step requests ten iterations without setting the pause field, the last motor speeds stay published, and the navigator publishes its own /X3/ros/motor_speed commands at 100 Hz unless it runs in control_mode rl_train. The upstream step continues on stale odometry after a 2 s wall-clock wait with only a warning. Seeded repeats hold for the fake only.
